decisions.rationale: runway_id (bronze id) has distinct_count 10760 equal to row_count 10760 with null_count 0, uniquely identifying each row, so it is declared the sole grain key.
duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 10760, so no duplicate rows exist in bronze and dedupe_strategy is set to none.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and carry no business meaning, so all three are dropped.

runway_id and airport_reference_id land as VARCHAR but every sampled value is a plain integer string with no nulls, matching the operator's description of internal integer identifiers, so both are cast to INTEGER; airport_ident and the end identifiers stay VARCHAR because their samples include non-numeric codes like '03N' and '-12'.

The low_end_ and high_end_ latitude, longitude, elevation, and heading columns carry null rates of roughly 22%-28% (e.g. le_latitude_deg null_rate 0.220911, he_elevation_ft null_rate 0.276208), reflecting runway ends whose geometry was never published, so they are retained nullable rather than imputed or dropped.

le_displaced_threshold_ft has null_rate 0.884201 (9514 of 10760 rows) and he_displaced_threshold_ft has null_rate 0.899907 (9683 of 10760 rows), consistent with most runway ends having no displaced threshold, so both are retained nullable rather than dropped.

surface has 239 distinct values and the operator confirms the code list is open-ended (ASP, TURF, CON, GRS, GRE, WATER, UNK, and others), so surface_code remains nullable VARCHAR rather than an enumerated type.

purpose: This table holds one cleaned row per runway from the OurAirports public-domain dataset, describing each runway's physical dimensions, surface, lighting/closure status, and the geometry of its low-numbered and high-numbered ends, feeding downstream airport-infrastructure and routing analyses alongside the airports silver table.
usage: Join on airport_reference_id or airport_ident to the airports silver table to bring in airport context; filter or branch on is_closed before computing active-runway statistics, and expect many nulls in the low_end_/high_end_ latitude, longitude, elevation, heading, and displaced_threshold columns since those were sparsely published upstream (roughly 22%-28% null for geometry, and up to 90% null for displaced threshold).
limitations: surface_code is retained as free text because the surface coding scheme is not a fixed enumerated list (239 distinct values observed); displaced_threshold and end-geometry columns are heavily null (up to 89.99% for he_displaced_threshold_ft) and were not imputed; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic beyond the declared grain was applied.
